title: Unconditional BTC hourly return reversal
claim: The latest BTC hourly return has a stable negative coefficient and improves the next-hour return forecast over registered controls.
mechanism: Temporary price concessions reverse as liquidity providers absorb one-sided demand.
target: Next one-hour BTC perpetual log return
primaryBaseline: Stronger of expanding historical mean, zero return, and positive-return persistence

evidence.summary: All development slopes were positive, the final slope was negative, and holdout RMSE was worse than mean and zero-return controls.

nextAction: Keep this unconditional version rejected; a liquidity-conditioned version requires independently accumulated BBO/L2 data and a fresh plan.
